summary: Reproduced all three independent-review counterexamples against candidate abf75d1860543491105348b87de9615268245e20. Function output arrays now retain text boundaries and serialize schema-valid image/file parts into the chat-compatible tool string instead of dropping them.

tests.what_was_measured: Before the correction, schema-valid image-only and file-only outputs normalized to an empty string, mixed text/image/text normalized to beforeafter, and the two-text issue payload lost its part boundary.
Eight focused input-item normalization regressions passed, including string, text-array, image-only, file-only, mixed-array, and unsupported-item boundaries.
The complete Responses serving unit file passed: 39 tests and 2 subtests.
All applicable repository formatting, lint, safety, and registered-test checks passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: ROCm reported the assigned gfx950 GPU in evidence/environment.txt, but this deterministic schema/normalization correction did not execute GPU kernels.

remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 weights and the reported parser/DSPARK configuration were unavailable; architecture-specific generation was not tested.
Non-text function outputs must be represented textually because Chat tool messages accept strings or text parts, not image/file parts; compact JSON preserves the original part data for the model.
